name: Biomedical Sciences PhD
summary: Biomedical Sciences PhD with laboratory rotations and flexibility to explore research areas across molecular, cellular and translational science.

deadlines.label: Final application and all supporting materials

timeline.interviews: Selected applicants have virtual faculty interviews, followed by campus invitations. On-campus visits take place in January and March.

applicationFee.note: Application fee shown in the 2026–27 fee table; confirm the fee for the new application cycle and any additional application-service charge. No applicable waiver policy verified.

english.note: Official scores required for non-native English speakers and must be no more than two years old. US study or foreign English-medium institution exceptions are considered case by case.

documents: GradCAS application and MUSC supplemental application
Transcripts from every postsecondary institution (official records required after an offer)
Personal statement, maximum 1,000 words, on career goals and program choice
Professionally evaluated foreign academic records in English
requirements.note: Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required before enrolling. GPA 3.0 or greater is a favorable guideline, not a single admission cutoff. No course prerequisites, but research experience should be demonstrated. Three letters preferably from scientific/health-care instructors or supervisors.

funding.note: Program publishes a $39,000 annual stipend effective July 1,2026, with tuition, fees and health insurance covered. The funding paragraph does not separately establish international eligibility; confirm the individual offer.
